notes.title: Blast Off to an Epic Audio Adventure!
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce the latest update to our virtual reality game, Space Blockbuster. After listening to user feedback, we've made significant improvements to the game's sound effects and background music. The result is a more immersive and enjoyable gaming experience that will take you on a journey through space like never before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/132bd7836e8e47d1f8aec9319be2f9b8ec53d242.jpg[/img]

One of the major changes in this update is the [i][b]complete overhaul of the game's background music[/b][/i]. We've listened to users and made the game's soundtrack even more exciting and impressive. Additionally, we have increased the number of music tracks and changed the stage themes for each chapter, as well as for each boss battle, and for every mode.

[i][b]The game's sound effects have also been enhanced[/b][/i], particularly with impact sounds. We've refined the game's audio to make the sounds of each blast and collision more realistic, allowing players to better feel the impact of their swings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/5660c1307a08bf83b7329e23de7c08c9dd963d82.gif[/img]

With all of these updates, we really feel Space Blockbuster's new sound experience is sure to be a hit with players of all levels. So, come and enjoy the game's new sounds and effects, and immerse yourself in the an exciting journey through space!

notes.title: Travel through the solar system!
notes.notes:
It’s your job to destroy the aliens and stop them from taking over our solar system. Each chapter represents a different wave of 10 stages of aliens, each with their own unique stage and character designs.

[b]Chapter 1. Mercury (10 stages)
Chapter 2. Venus (10 stages)
Chapter 3. Earth (10 stages)
Chapter 4. Mars (10 stages)[/b]
 


[h1][b]Mercury[/b][/h1]
Starting at Mercury, you’ll mostly be learning how to play the game. The aliens are bigger, and easier to destroy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/46ad1fd55101b531467de08c4e654dfe27fb31c2.png[/img]



[h1][b]Venus[/b][/h1]
As you make your way to Venus and beyond, you’ll slowly come up against increasingly difficult challenges. At the same time you’ll gradually gain access to a larger variety of rackets and abilities to help you take out the oncoming waves of space aliens. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/fcc4e139c53c988952e4996aec1b874f4fb23ff0.gif[/img]


[h1][b]Earth[/b][/h1]
Welcome home, space traveller! You've still got a ways to go before you're done!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/c90b099b28d2f7b5e380f6962b6a7a93a3aea28b.png[/img]



[h1][b]Mars[/b][/h1]
Each planet is slightly more difficult than the one before it, with Mars being for people who are looking for a challenge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/ab0bdb22d515e4a43f13a16dc7718e0862fcf69c.png[/img]



[h1][b]Endless Mode[/b][/h1]
And if you’re still looking for a way to test your worth, you can always hop over to endless mode and see how long you can last.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/58c55e852d896e711d01c6d5d1ca763ce03d4ebf.gif[/img]

notes.title: All Kinds of Modes & Stages!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Protect the solar system![/b][/h2]

Aliens have invaded the inner solar system, and it’s your job to stop them.
Starting at Mercury, and working your way to Mars, you’ll need to defeat the aliens and take out their boss on each planet.

[h3][u][b]Test your mettle with three different modes:[/b][/u][/h3]
[list]
[*][h2][b]Campaign Mode[/b][/h2]
Start slow and build your skills against increasingly difficult stages and bosses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/6ab1021220b8c70476000702fb0b56b4f6e0743f.gif[/img]


[*][h2][b]Multiplayer Mode[/b][/h2]
Play against your friends, or other players around the world in multiplayer mode!
You may think you’re good, but are you the best?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/486dbf97818f975fe1c45cfa328eb3bd68f03bf2.gif[/img]


[*][h2][b]Endless Mode[/b][/h2]
It’s not over until it’s over! Endless mode is a battle of endurance. The aliens keep coming, but can you stop them? Endless mode has two versions: “with items” & “without items”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/58c55e852d896e711d01c6d5d1ca763ce03d4ebf.gif[/img]
[/list]


[h3][u][b]Improve your skills on each stage with Space Block Buster’s 3 different stage types:[/b][/u][/h3]
[list]
[*][h2][b]Regular Stages[/b][/h2]
It’s just like the block busting games you’re used to, except this time it’s in 3D! Use buffs and avoid debuffs to defeat the space aliens!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/6ab1021220b8c70476000702fb0b56b4f6e0743f.gif[/img]

[*][h2][b]Centipede Stages[/b][/h2]
The space aliens are weaving back and forth as they crawl towards you… Defeat them before they get too close!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/fcc4e139c53c988952e4996aec1b874f4fb23ff0.gif[/img]


[*][h2][b]Boss Stages[/b][/h2]
At the end of every stage, you’ll have to defeat the boss to move on to the next planet. Each boss has its own attacks and tricks up its sleeve, so stay on your toes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/c9d8fc1312f726cf38892d9e1b5a8817bde62439.gif[/img]
[/list]

notes.title: Space Block Buster is AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.notes:
‘Space Block Buster’ reinterprets the breakout-style games of our past into a fast-paced high-quality VR game with the cutest aliens you've ever seen.

The goal of the game is to break all the blocks in the arena, but the game is over if the blocks creep to close to you (in later levels), the ball gets behind you, or after you've destroyed all of the balls in the arena. To make the game even more fun, you'll have the chance to upgrade your arms from rackets to all sorts of things like bats, and guns. With different patterns of balls on each stage, you'll find plenty of interesting challenges along your path through the solar system.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/f6f44d4cb11c8aa0df7e85d84c84f2c50c3d6412.png[/img]

notes.title: Major Update (Centipede Stage)
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Space Block Buster: Centipede Stage Update
[/b][/h2]

[h3][b][Centipede Stage]
[/b][/h3]

: For much more exciting play, Centipede stage that pressures the play with its own movements is added. 
Experience your nostalgic game in VR space.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/667c2e020fe129cb5ae2841558922c61afd8387a.png[/img]



[h3][b][Game Play][/b]
[/h3]

1) 'Space Block Buster: Centipede Stage' maintains the same form as existing blocks, and can be destroyed using a ball. Since Centipede’s movement is very irregular, you need to focus as much as possible to target its head.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/a82584c10d16b8cc73beb8b4f24d319ef07728ef.gif[/img]



2) When Centipede’s head is destroyed, the body breaks down along. But when the body is destroyed while the head is undamaged, it separates into 2 or more and gives stronger pressure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/fcc4e139c53c988952e4996aec1b874f4fb23ff0.gif[/img]

The stage consists of 4~5 waves in total. As the stage progresses, Centipede with higher HP appears or the body is designed to destroy easily.


3) Centipede turns into a Bullet Block when it reaches a certain area, and begins to attack. The number of close blocks must be reduced as much as possible. As the more close blocks you have, the more simultaneous attacks you will receive. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/fe758683294f561780937658744a300c43628204.gif[/img]



[h3][b][Score Initialization, Lobby UI Improvement][/b]
[/h3]

: 4 chapters of Space Block Buster has 10 stages each, and Centipede replaces 2 stages of each chapter. This will initialize some of the existing stage's scores, and players can earn points by playing the Centipede stage.

Stages that include Centipede has different icon background from existing stages, which makes it easier to distinguish.
(1-4, 1-8, 2-4, 2-8, 3-4, 3-8, 4-4, 4-8 Stage)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/6017a7be3d013f617d85038d7b09d941985732f8.png[/img]

notes.title: Major Update (Multiverse Mode)
notes.notes:
Multiverse Mode has been added through the update.
Multiverse Mode is a PVP mode that allows you to compete against other players and compare your game skills with opponents.

[h2][Round Configuration]
[/h2]Multiverse Mode consists of a total of 3 rounds. The time of each round, the number of blocks and the HP of the blocks will gradually increase, and the player can use the item to remove the block faster than the opponent or eliminate the opponent using the attack item to win the game.

During each round, a warm-up time of less than 5 seconds is given, and information on items that will appear in that round is announced. It is recommended for players to check this before taking on the stage, or plan to eliminate opponents. Of course, it is also possible to use the warm-up time to provoke or mock the opponent next to you. There are no restrictions on enjoying space sports, except for foul play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/486dbf97818f975fe1c45cfa328eb3bd68f03bf2.gif[/img]

[h2][Description of Additional Items]
[/h2]Attack items that can only be used in Multiverse Mode have been added.

[b]1. Boxing Glove changes the opponent's racket into a boxing glove.
[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/f25b37c28fbb7cd3ae6750df1d831c626646e293.png[/img]

[b]2. Acoustic Guitar changes the opponent's racket into an acoustic guitar.
[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/9f61591ad57a9f8b9c12536afd160a4b9e75370a.png[/img]

[b]3. Broom Stick changes the opponent's racket into a broom.
[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/d64bf29bf5d768909bc3b7edbadafff63fbcecb8.png[/img]

[b]4. Speed Up increases the opponent's ball speed.
[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/1c94f78e1303e24b0c54be1fbafde851df3a7033.png[/img]

[b]5. Little Pong makes the opponent's ball small.
[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/5925fd99488dd16d4ef7895377740010667fd3a8.png[/img]

You must use the new items added to interfere with your opponent's game. Interference will be applied to the opponent in the direction of the racket used to acquire the item. Players who are affected by the item effect should not panic and prepare by checking the countdown that appears before the effect begins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/a49bc9974629560c84e4b334161f67b5d10fd04c.gif[/img]

[h2][Tip]
[/h2]You can play normally even if your opponent accidentally loses their life and is out of the round first. Using this time to get the most points is critical to winning. Conversely, a 'perfect round' happens if someone first removes all the blocks spawned on the stage. If someone achieves a perfect round, the round ends immediately and the next round begins. In other words, the key to victory is to achieve a perfect round or to interfere and get the opponent out.

notes.title: SPACE BLOCK BUSTER is Releasing NOW!
notes.notes:
‘Space Block Buster’ reinterprets brick breakout game which everyone has a memory of once enjoying it in the past, into an addictive high-quality VR game with a sense of crazy parody.

A basic rule of the game is to break all blocks in the stadium, but the game is defeated if the block reaches a dangerous area or a certain number of balls are missing. To make the game more fun, various blocks with craziness have diverse forms and effects, and they appear in different patterns with the stage. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/f6f44d4cb11c8aa0df7e85d84c84f2c50c3d6412.png[/img]

notes.title: ‘Space Block Buster’ will be launched for Early Access on Dec. 20th
notes.notes:
‘Space Block Buster’ will be launched at Steam VR Platform for Early Access on December 20th.
This game reinterprets brick breakout game which everyone has a memory of once enjoying it in the past, into an addictive high-quality VR game with a sense of crazy parody.

Space Block Buster’ combined ‘Bat and Ball’ game system based on the rules of breakout genre, to provide a colorful fun experience. 
Though the game will be first released in single-play mode, multi-player mode support is in the plan for updates. 
The game challenges players with 30 stages and bosses which level of difficulty increases gradually, and lets players compete with others by each stage’s scores. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309026/63965b8f44647e3dae33c36db23422322036187f.png[/img]
